name: add-camera-camx
description: Vendor CamX camera stack (hardware ISP) for the IMX519 on CSI1 and CSI2, 4-lane with autofocus. Installs the userspace stack plus an integration package that owns the per-SoC layout and diverts the stock socid_map. Ordinary V4L2 clients are served by camx-v4l2-bridge, which holds the HAL3 camera open and republishes frames on a v4l2loopback node; the service is enabled on first install. The DT overlay is staged under /usr/share/tachyon/dtbo for the user to deploy - this overlay never touches /boot/dtb_a. EXPERIMENTAL: the tuning data is not calibrated for this module, so images are softer than the sensor can manage.
